# Grow your own cannabis and coca plants, cook meth and cocaine and Sell 🌿
 Hop on your skateboard to navigate the city, dodge the cops and Cartel and sell your product. Adding Mixers to your base batches you can maximize your profits and watch your customers react to your custom batches.
